author: Zekard92
quote:
FYI: this game come from 1998 and set rules for designing 3d levels, dungeons, combat, puzzles. So many other games inherited all that knowledge as per the Z-Trigger feature evolved into enemy focus or auto-aim for many games of all genres.
Ocarina is fun and interesting, but you have in mind that you cannot judge it with the same ruler you use for high-paced action games of the modern scene, because they inherited and enhanced what zelda did.
Their graphics are groundbreaking compared with it's own past, not against it future, so are it's other features.
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time (1998)
